statement.zh: **事件**：AES 竞赛启动与 Rijndael 选定（AES Call for Candidates and Rijndael Selection）。FIPS 197-upd1 §2.1 的词表把 Rijndael 定义为「The block cipher that NIST selected as the winner of the AES competition」；§1 说明本标准指定该族的三个实例化 AES-128、AES-192、AES-256，并指出 Rijndael 另支持的分组与密钥长度未被本标准采纳。
statement.en: **Event**: AES Call for Candidates and Rijndael Selection.It is registered under symmetric block ciphers, dated 1997.

statement.zh: 这是一个公开的竞赛过程：§1 写明「In 1997, NIST initiated the Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) development effort」并「called for the public to submit candidate algorithms for block ciphers」，同节又以「In 2000, NIST announced the selection of Rijndael [2, 3] for the AES」记录结果；摘要同样写「In 2000, NIST announced the selection of the Rijndael block cipher family as the winner of the Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) competition」。
statement.en: It is listed because it connects concrete records, objects or procedures in symmetric block ciphers, not because of its name.

statement.zh: 算法的出处写在参考文献表：[2] 为「Joan Daemen and Vincent Rijmen.AES Proposal: Rijndael Document Version 2.AES Algorithm Submission, September 1999」，[3] 为二人的「The Design of Rijndael - The Advanced Encryption Standard (AES), Second Edition.Information Security and Cryptography.Springer, 2020」。标准正文据此把提交的算法固为可部署的三种密钥长度实例，并在 §1 说明分组密码的地位：「Block ciphers are the foundation for many cryptographic services, especially those that provide assurance of the confdentiality of data」（转文本把 confidentiality 的 fi 连字印作 confdentiality）。
statement.en: Fix the object and its aliases; list the sourced dates, roles, parameters or inscriptions; state the observable output; then test the boundary.Any step without a source stops there rather than being filled with prose.

statement.zh: 标准只记录年份与结果，不记录竞赛规模与评审细节：文中出现的是 1997 年启动、2000 年选定，未在该条目目所引段落中给出候选算法数量、轮次或淘汰标准，也未在正文叙述中提及设计者姓名（姓名只出现在参考文献）。公告第 12 项规定标准每五年正式复审，因此算法地位也需按该周期复核。
statement.en: The boundary separates a sourced fact, a model-derived relation and an unverified gap.Secondary summaries yield to primary material; unsourced dates, counts and device values stay blank.

statement.zh: 与实体名对应的年份在文档中有明确定位：1997 年是 AES 工作启动与公开征集的年份，2000 年是宣布选定 Rijndael 的年份，标准本身于 2001 年 11 月 26 日发布、2023 年 5 月 9 日更新。
statement.en: Registered period: Age of Standardization.The registered year is 1997; institutional placement and technical detail follow the cited sources.
